about: The owner's split of the missed posts the live judge (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, block v10, cutoff 0.70) still missed on 2026-10-17: 12 misses out of 33 missed posts. `teach` is always taught (with Policy.learning.alwaysTeach), whatever its hash. `test` is never taught as anything (a missed post, a tap, a label, a coined post) and is always in the re-tune's test: the six misses kept back plus the ten held-out missed posts the live judge already caught. `untaughtMisses` is the six misses in `test`, whose catch rate is reported on its own. The halves were picked so each has people, catchphrases or news, and videos on both sources; the two Portuguese video clips are one in each. The owner's gate (Policy.learning.ownerGate) reads `test`. Ids live here, not in the policy, because a post id names its source. An id must never be in both `teach` and `test`. `dropped` (the owner, 2026-10-18: the six once taught made the candidate worse twice) is never taught from any source, and is not tested.
